steps.label: Projekt entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat fd_v4_aa fd_v4_ab fd_v4_ac fd_v4_ad fd_v4_ae > film.tgz && cat md_v4_aa md_v4_ab > mixc.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q film.tgz)" = 8682b865d74b5e12feaca37d2a61d2fa ] && [ "$(md5 -q mixc.tgz)" = 2933d79bf56e5179935a26c6829330f7 ] && rm -rf src public && tar xzf film.tgz && tar xzf mixc.tgz && ls public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render src/index.jsx P out4.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > render_time4.txt

steps.label: Ton anlegen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out4.mp4 -i mix_full.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film4.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i peloton_film4.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy peloton_film4_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film4*.mp4 >> render_time4.txt
